fixture.actualDeletionTargetsDdl:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.deletion_targets (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  deletion_request_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.deletion_requests(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  target_id text NOT NULL,
  kind text NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('media_asset', 'storage_object', 'story', 'derived_artifact')),
  bucket text,
  object_key text,
  state text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
    CHECK (state IN ('pending', 'processing', 'failed', 'deleted', 'not_found')),
  error_code text,
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (deletion_request_id, target_id)
);

capture.selection: Four-object subset: selected published candidate, unrelated original chunk, unrelated reserved candidate, standalone legacy object. The selected story original chunk is captured but absent from this manifest subset.
capture.timestampConversion: Durable UTC microsecond timestamp retained in request; tombstone adapter normalizes to ISO UTC milliseconds required by existing Scheme B contract.
